name: Chevreuse
notes: A Pyro healer and buffer for Pyro and Electro teams (Overloaded). Her passive gives Pyro and Electro teammates up to 40% ATK from her Max HP, which is why HP is her scaling stat and 40,000 HP the goal (KQM's, and the top of Game8's 35,000-40,000). The sources agree on the Skill first, 4pc Noblesse Oblige and Song of Days Past, HP% Goblet and ER or HP% Sands. The Skill DMG lines marked 'check' are ATK multipliers; her healing is Max HP. ER 180% sits where KQM's Burst-every-rotation range (175-205%) and Game8's (160-200%) overlap. Both rank Black Tassel or Favonius Lance on the weapon list; KQM puts Symphonist of Scents first. Both also give a Pyro damage build, which the card leaves out.
